name.ja: <ruby>緋<rt>アケ</rt></ruby>ノ<ruby>異解△<rt>イカイ</rt></ruby>ナラカ

text.en: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Xenovader△ of Scarlet Naraka" once per turn. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 of your face-down banished Level 5 or higher "Xenovader△" monsters, also you cannot activate cards or effects for the rest of this turn, except "Xenovader△" cards or effects.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名的①③效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：对手将怪兽特殊召唤的情况下可以发动。从手牌将此卡特殊召唤。②：此卡召唤・特殊召唤的情况下发动。从自己牌组上面将4张卡以里侧除外。③：在对手的主要阶段可以发动。将自己除外状态（里侧）的1只等级5以上的“异解△”怪兽特殊召唤。此回合，自己不可发动“异解△”卡以外的卡的效果。
